tasks.title: Refactor runPipelineReviewStage to multi-round with roundState and self-check
tasks.description: Rewrite `runPipelineReviewStage` in `workflow-controller.ts` to use a `roundState` object (mirroring Plan stage pattern at line 91-110). Round 0 sends reviewer prompt. After round 0 succeeds, update roundState to `{ type: 'review-self-check', index: 1 }`, emit `plan_round_start`, and send the self-check prompt via `conn.prompt()`. On self-check failure, return `success: false`. After both rounds, read `review.md` (fallback to self-check result.text), validate non-empty, then `conn.close()`. Keep the existing error/catch structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Review stage sends two conn.prompt() calls on the same connection
Round 0 emits plan_round_start with roundType 'review', roundIndex 0
Round 1 emits plan_round_start with roundType 'review-self-check', roundIndex 1
onSessionUpdate closure reads roundState.type and roundState.index for plan_session_update events
Round 0 failure returns success:false without attempting round 1
Round 1 failure returns success:false with requiresApproval:false
Final review.md is read after self-check round, non-empty validation applied
conn.close() called only after both rounds complete (or on early failure)
Review prompt (review.md) includes instruction to output only final report with no thinking/reasoning
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Import buildReviewSelfCheckPrompt from artifact-prompt.ts. The roundState mutation + onSessionUpdate closure pattern is proven in Plan stage (lines 91-110). Do NOT close the connection between rounds.
